meta.name: Standard Operating Procedure
meta.description: In 2004, during the invasion of Iraq, the public learned of systemic sexual abuse, torture, rape and even murder going on inside Abu Ghraib prison in Baghdad. Photographs taken by the soldiers themselves were at the centre of the scandal, and seared public consciousness.Standard Operating Proceduresets out to examine the context of these photographs. Why were they taken? What was happening outside the frame? And as the film provides direct accounts of the soldiers who took the photographs and who were in the photographs, we ask: Who are these people? What were they thinking?
